audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built around 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' — focus.text, loading, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0] ('Vault (E) knockback-nearsight'), early ('Vault (E) knocks you back and blinds') and wants.foe[1]. Vault does none of that. Riot: Quinn dashes TO the enemy, deals damage and SLOWS, then leaps off, briefly interrupting the target, and lands at her max attack range. The blind/vision effect belongs to Blinding Assault (Q).
audit.why: The player is told to fear a knockback-blind that does not exist, and is never told the two things that do matter: the blind is on a separate 11s cooldown and only stops AUTO-ATTACKS (Infected Bonesaw and Heart Zapper still land through it), and Vault briefly interrupts him mid-combo. Getting this right changes when he steps up — he waits out Q, not E.
audit.corrected: Ability effects reassigned correctly in phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault listed at 11s (that is its rank-2 value); no other cooldown appears anywhere. The packet flags zero sequencing cues on this matchup.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8 and Blinding Assault 11/10.5/10/9.5/9. Those two numbers are the entire 'when do I walk at her' decision, and the page gave the player neither.
audit.corrected: Rank-1 values written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, phases[2].why and phases[4].why, each attached to a concrete 'wait for X, then Y'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6, First item and 2+ items are all 'Skill' in both layers, while content spikes[1] ('you tip favored at 6'), spikes[2] ('clearly ahead'), spikes[3] ('firmly yours'), mid, late and the packet chart all give those stages to Dr. Mundo. The full layer also calls it 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Quinn carry threat 8.5/10' while diff reads FAV.
audit.why: Mundo wins 54.56% here and every prose field says the lane flips at 6. An 8/10 difficulty and 8.5/10 carry threat on a matchup the champion wins is the page arguing against itself.
audit.corrected: Level 6, First item and 2+ items flipped to Dr. Mundo in both layers as one chart edit; difficulty and carry ratings brought to 6/10 with the summary text matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's whys[] are shifted one row earlier than their labels: whys[3] says 'through level 4' on the Levels 4-5 row, whys[4] says 'at level 5' on the Level 6 row, whys[5] says 'your level-6 R' on the First item row.
audit.why: Every row after the third describes the stage above it, so a player reading the chart gets advice for the wrong level.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and whys[5] realigned to their own rows. whys[3] left alone — its text is true of Levels 4-5 either way — but the shift should be checked across the whole champion.

notes: IMPORTANT — the _missing-interactions entry claims 'Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines (R) is a channel — your Goes Where He Pleases (P) cancels it outright.' NOT WRITTEN: Dr. Mundo's passive resists an incoming immobilize, it applies no CC, so it cannot interrupt any channel. This is the same bad rule that fired on the pantheon matchup — it needs fixing at the generator, not per matchup. The suspectNames hit on 'Her Behind Enemy Lines' is a FALSE POSITIVE. Quinn's R shows cd '3' in the kit file, which is the recast/duration value rather than a real cooldown, so I quoted no number for it.
